How do I learn to be as good at circuit boards as you? I'm 32, is it too late? Will I never understand?

What you see there is a PCB (Printed Circuit Board)
You would typically have that laid out on a breadboard, using through-hole components.
If it works on a breadboard, THEN you can use a CAD program, Altium was my preference, get the gerber files and NC Drill files sent out to the manufacturer.
PCBs are a little more "permanent" so making sure it works is priority.
